by its probability, and find the sum.
The mean is 0.18, which is interpreted in the following way. You should expect to win an
average of $0.18 per game you play. If you prefer, you can copy the table into STATBELT and
use the Custom Discrete Probability Calculator. But, with only two outcomes to multiply, it did
not take much work to find the expected value by hand.
For 100 bets, multiply the expected value per game by the number of bets: You should expect
to make about $18. Certainly not a lot for that many bets, but since the probability of winning
and losing are very close, you should expect to win only slightly more often than you lose.
: Expected Value of a $10 Bet in Roulette
In roulette, a small ball is dropped into a spinning wheel and comes to rest in one of 38 spaces. The potential
landing spots for the ball are numbered 1 through 36, plus 0 and 00, (for a total of 38 spaces). There are 18
red spaces, 18 black spaces, and 2 that are green (0 and 00). There are many types of bets a player can make.
Find the expected value of each $10 bet explained below. Which bet has the highest expected value?
If a player makes a “straight up” bet, they choose one of the 38 numbers on the wheel. If the ball
lands on their number, they win $350. If the ball does not land on their number, they lose $10.
If a player makes a “Red” bet, they are betting the ball will land in a red space. They will win $10 if
the ball lands in a red space and will lose $10 if it does not.
If a player makes a “first dozen” bet, they are betting the ball will land on 1-12. If the ball lands on
any spaced marked 1-12, they will win $20. If it does not land on 1-12, they will lose $10.
The “straight up” bet has a probability of winning of 1/38, and a probability of losing of 37/38.
So, the expected value can be calculated by finding the mean of the discrete probability
